chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Ishaq, from Sa'dan, from Dawood al-Raqqi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Do not leave supplicating with this supplication three times when you rise in the morning, and three times when you enter the evening: 'O Allah, make me within Your fortified shield, in which You place whomever You will,' for my father (peace be upon him) used to say: 'This is from the treasured supplications.'

key_terms.إِذَا أَصْبَحْتَ: When you rise in the morning

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended morning and evening supplication for divine protection in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) prescribes this specific supplication for morning and evening recitation, invoking Allah’s 'fortress' (dir') as a spiritual shield against daily trials. He highlights its status as a 'treasured' (makhzun) prayer, indicating its preservation within the Ahl al-Bayt's esoteric tradition and its transmission from his father, Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him). This practice underscores the Shia emphasis on utilizing inherited prophetic wisdom for daily spiritual protection and divine proximity.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Is’haq, from Sa’dan, from Dawood Al Raqqy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Do not leave supplicating with this supplication, three times, when it is morning, and three times when it is evening – ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Make me to be in Your<sup>azwj</sup> Fortified Shield which You<sup>azwj</sup> Cause to be in it the one You<sup>azwj</sup> Want to’, for my<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘This is from the treasured supplications’.
en.sarwar: 37. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ahmad ibn Ishaq from Su’Dan from Dawud al-Raqqi from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

Do not miss saying in the morning and in the evening three times this, ‘O Lord, place me in Your strong coat of arms in which You place whomever You will’; my father would say that this is of the prayer that is treasured.’”
